Eligibility of Tenderer : This invitation for Tender is open to all eligible Reputed Supplier as mentioned below as further detailed in the Tender Data Sheet
(TDS) as well as Particular Conditions of Contract (PCC) of the Tender Document.
a. The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the supply of Goods and related services as supplier
shall be Five (05) years.
b. The minimum specific experience as supplier in supply of goods of at least One (1) contracts successfully completed within the
last 03 (Three) years, each with a value of at least Tk. 2000000 (Twenty Lac) Only.
c. The minimum supply and/or production capacity of Goods is/are: 6000000 (Sixty Lac) only for year.
d. The minium amount of liquid assets i.e. working capital or credit ilne(s) of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 4000000 (Forty Lac) only. In
case of credit line, Specific Format which is attached in Section: 9 (drawing), must be used.
e. The Tenderer must have up to date Income Tax clearance Certificate from the NBR with TIN up- to- 2015-2016 (Tax Year).
f. The Tenderer must have up- to- date VAT Registration Certificate.
g. The Tenderer must have up- to- date valid Trade License.(Document must be Submitted for the Year of 2012-2013 To 2016-
2017).
